nom: The Ordinary Glycolipid Cream Cleanser for Dry Skin and Makeup Removal

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love this product being using it for over a year makes my skin feel amazing clean clearly and soft
The product is great, however the checkout clerk should receive additional training.
This is the only skincare line I will use. I have very sensitive getting mature skin. I have to be careful what I use. This works well for me and it's very afordable.

I really do LOVE this product as well as I love The Ordinary Skin Care Line as a whole! It definitely helps me remove my makeup as well as wash my face. It goes on well & washes off well leaving my skin feeling hydrated & fresh! Definitely recommend!
This is a great face cleanser. Very gentle, but cleans off makeup exceptionally well. Does not dry the skin.

avis.titre: Just love it! So gentle on sensitive skin.
avis.texte: Best face wash for sensitive skin, its odor free and made of good stuff.

I prefer those thick luxury fragranced cleansing balms, but unfortunately cant always splurge on them. My first time removing my stage makeup with this I was very surprised it left me squeaky clean. Just two squeezes of product, massage onto face, rinse with water. Totally satisfied.

I have dry, sensitive skin, and wear no makeup at all most of the time, so this totally works for me. The smell is typical of any "fragrance-free" product (I use many), which is just the smell of the ingredients. I find it to be inoffensive/likeable even, and doesn't last any longer than the moment you put it on and wash it off. It is gentle, moisturizing, and non-irritating.
I use this as the second step in my double cleanse. Product works great and is non irritating, as I have very sensitive skin.
It smelled like celery and did a horrible job getting my face clean. Will not purchase again.

Feels nice going on and does not dry out your skin. However, I bought it to remove my makeup at the end of the day and it does not do that. I have to use something else like a Neutrogena Makeup Remover wipe which defeats the purpose. If you do not wear make up this might work just fine for you.

I like this cleanser and I feel like it works well for my sensitive combo acne prone skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft and not stripped. It will be a nice cream cleanser to use as I enter the colder months. I'm taking one star off because it smells like coconut and celery, which I'm not a big fan of.

This is my go-to facial cleanser. I have very sensitive skin. The glycolipid cleanser is lightweight, and fragrance free (which is great) and cleans my face very well without stripping oils or drying it out. I follow it up with other The Ordinary products (serums and moisturizer) after. Skin appearance has improved greatly since using this product and all The Ordinary products. I also very rarely get breakouts now, which is also a plus. I'm so happy I found the brand.

I had my reservations about using this cleanser but decided to give it go, my opinion is that i love this cleanser not only is it gentle on the face i feel my skin has improved because of it. That and it smells like coconut to me, I was afraid it would smell rancid like some reviews claim but it just smells like a natural coconut, maybe coconut milk? Anyway I am mot the most consistent with my skincare but this cleanser doesnt dry me out, creamy cleansers are recommended for people with fry and sensitive skin so I had a feeling it would be okay on me. I do have concerns about it being too gentle? Like it doesnt cleanse like i need it to? But if you're someone who needs something gentle and soothing is this for you ;)

avis.titre: Meant to be a first cleanse!
avis.texte: This is meant to be a first cleanse, and to follow up with another cleanser. The really cool thing about is is the packaging and the formula. Its not something you have to warm up in your hands, or something so thin that it runs down your hands like an oil. Really like the teaxture and light scent.

So I have fairly sensitive skin, I do not wear make up or sunscreen on my face. This left my face feeling greasy and still unclean. The fragrance is odd, it's not overwhelming, but it's definitely there. The fragrance disappeared pretty quickly after I started rubbing it around my face to cleanse so maybe it's just as it comes out? It didn't burn or give me a rash, just didn't cleanse either. if you're looking for a gentle cleanser from this brand just go with the squalane cleanser.
didn't make me break out and made my skin feel good, would definitely Recommend to people with sensitive skin. Good ingredients, good packaging. A lot of product and smell is not bad.

avis.titre: Decent product for a decent price
avis.texte: I really enjoy this cream cleanser. It feels really gentle on my skin when it is feeling extra sensitive. I don't think it is strong enough to truly remove all of my makeup though if I'm using it in that capacity. Overall a decent product especially for the reasonable price.

avis.titre: Great everyday cleanser for drier skin
avis.texte: My skin is on the dry side and most cleansers leave it feeling tight and stripped. This cleanser doesn't dry out my skin, but still cleans thoroughly enough to get rid of the closed comedones I had with my old cream cleanser.
It was moisturizing cleansing cream. But it felt likey face was not clean after using it. I also noticed it did not get makeup off very well. Nice product, but I likely would not purchase

It is amazing its so gentle, affordable, and lasts a long time. Its great for in the morning or afternoon. Ive been using it for about four months and it has not broke me out in acne infact it has helped with my acne. Hope this helped 🙂😊🙂.

I love this cleanser. It feels so amazing on the skin and sensation of it is therapeutic while washing my face. This winter has been rough on my face and I switched to this one and I just LOVE IT. I dont think it has a weird smell it kinda smells like faint oatmeal to me nothing crazy. It takes off all my makeup which is such a plus but I do double cleanse still. Such a staple now everyone should try it. It also lasts along time I feel like I squeeze alot everytime I use it because it doesnt foam like im used too but not upset about it!

avis.titre: Saves time and money - I don't have to double cleanse
avis.texte: I don't have to double cleanse anymore. It cleanses my skin and removes my makeup which includes ilia mascara, Bobbi brown eyeliner pot, ilia foundation and mineral sunscreen. I no longer have to use micellar water. Thank you!

the product feels really light weight and left me with the super clean cool feeling after using it, huge bonus was it not irritating my skin!! i knocked off one star just because it's not something i would use daily just because my skin usually acts up if i use chemicals too many days in a row

avis.titre: Left my face soft and cleansed!
avis.texte: This product cleaned my face so well! It left it super soft and moisturized however I didn't enjoy the smell of the product, but overall, love it!
This stuff was amazing and I loved that the package was so simple. I feel like it helped my skin and I like that it has no scent. Texture is great and the ingredients are too
I am still using this today. It's a gentle cleanser that is great for removing makeup and as a first step in a double cleanse. I would definitely recommend.

I like to use The ordinary products. I always have a good experience with them. This cleanser is so gentle, makes my skin feel so soft and clean. I struggle with some bad acne and this cream does not irritate it. I also love that even though it has a creamy formula, it does a very good job at removing makeup and impurities.
I didn't receive my product but I have used this before and it is good if you have sensitive prone skin. For the price it's a good product but if you're wanting more results I'd look elsewhere.

okay so its been 6 months since i have started using THE Ordinary products and it never dissapointed me... and recently i have purchased this Glycolipid cream Cleanser... unaware of it being a makeup remover but when i used it for the first i was in so much awe and happy the way it felt on my face.... it made my skin soft supple and plumy ...the best cleanser i have used till now... it makes my face shine ... :) And now my question is... can i continue using it for cleansing like a face wash even though i do not use makeup..????
This us a great cleanser. Very gentle, removes makeup and leaves your skin feeling moisturized. Highly reccomend.

For a normal wash, the Glycolipid Cream Cleanser may be okay, but don't expect it to remove makeup. I don't wear a lot of makeup, so I was surprised that I had such a difficult time removing the little I had on. This cleanser forced me to wash my face three times, just to get the last of my mascara off, which isn't even a waterproof mascara. Since the cleanser had such a difficult time removing such a small amount of makeup, I'm concerned that it also doesn't clean my skin effectively in one wash. For now, I'll stick to something that I know (Squalane Cleanser) that both removes makeup effectively and cleans my skin properly.

My skin had so many issues, dry patches, rawness, fine lines, etc.. I began using the this line including; the moisturizer, eye serum, hyaluronic acid, and cleanser about 2 months ago and never have I had so much success. I love the results!

I love a good simple cleanser thats affordable, removes makeup, and doesn't breakout my skin. The ordinary never fails me and this cleanser was no exception. I love how you can use it with or without water (even though I prefer using water). And I love how my skin feels after rinsing off the product. Definitely recommend for someone looking for a good simple cleanser.

avis.titre: I was surprised at how great my skin felt
avis.texte: This cleanser left my face feeling very clean, smooth and soft. I didn't think I would like it, but I'll be ordering this again and again. To whomever created this cleanser, good job!

I use this cleanser to remove makeup: mascara, light brow powder and a serum based foundation. It works perfectly. I wiped a kleenex on my face to see if there was any residue left over and there wasn't. I'm not sure how it work if I wore heavier makeup such as eye shadow and lipstick? I use the foaming cleanser for days I am not wearing any makeup and that is perfect.

avis.titre: Great cleanser, but OMG the SMELL
avis.texte: No one is saying anything about the stench of this stuff, so I want to make it clear to anyone else. The smell of this stuff sets off my gag reflex. It is absolutely a good cleanser, but I a can't use it due to the ungodly aroma. Threw out sadly.
i liked it but it wasn't for me, the cleanser isn't a foaming cleanser like i'm use but other than that i would definitely recommend it for dry skin
I love everything comes from the ordinary, the quality the price cruelty free I love everything. The size it is perfect, I used everyday I so Some results in my skin.
This is fantastic. Doesnt make feel dry afterwards, which most cleansers would. Smell is mild and pleasant. Bottle isnt mess and is easy to hold when my hands.are wet

I bought it cause I was really in need of a cleanser that can also remove my very light makeup that I use for work daily, sadly it doesn't remove makeup right away, I have to use it two or even three times to see my face a bit cleaner but traces of makeup are still there.

I'm obsessed with this basic cleanser! Even though it smells like rotten cilantro to me 🤢 I love the creamy consistency, it doesn't break me out and leaves my face feeling soft and not stripped in the slightest. If your cleanser is giving you "squeaky clean" you're using the wrong one. This removes my regular makeup + sunscreen on dry skin with ease but it probably wouldn't work well for people who wear water resistant so just keep that in mind. I already ordered 2 more as backup!

Save yr money bc this cleanser honestly is aweful bc its very stripping. Im a makeup artist and I had an event so I had thought I'd try this the week prior. Big mistake my skin was badly striped and severely red. Luckily I went to a dermatologist and he saved my skin just in time for my event. I love all other products the ordinary has. Please try the squalene cleanser. Much better.
I tend to use foaming formulas so this was a nice opportunity to try something different. It's definitely best suited for dry and/or sensitive skin (mine is oily/combo) but it gets the job done.
No major complaints with this product. I typically prefer a foaming cleanser but this one was good. It didn't have any fragrance that I could smell.

Absolutely love this for oily sensitive skin. I want to enjoy most cream cleansers but I also feel that they never manage to remove peeling, dead skin to where it has no benefit to my bumpy texture. This cleanser contains phytic acid, an AHA that I don't understand why TO didn't advertise as a selling point but maybe because this wash doesn't have a lot of it but seems to be the separating factor from other useless cream cleansers. Anyways, it's a great mild wash to use at any time, though I don't wear makeup so I can't attest to its removal properties. Also compatible with many actives like prescription tazarotene without irritation. I alternate this with a BHA cleanser at night for the best of both worlds.

I use this cleanser everyday and love it. It leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. I never feel like it's stripping away my moisture in my skin. It's effective in removing makeup and sunscreen. It's also great for my sensitive skin - no issues, even after first use.
Loved this my 16 yr old daughter does too great for sensitive skin makes your skin feel great and really helped clear her skin up also liked that it didnt really have any scent
Gentle but I feel like I have to go in w a second wash bc it doesn't always get all of my makeup off. Ordinary is a great brand at an affordable price though.

I have really loved the ordinary glycolipid cream cleaner as it doesn't strip my face of its moisture yet leaves my skin feel clean and refreshed. Best part it's super affordable what's not to to love!
Thus was my first try with this brand. I have heard great things, but now I am a believer! Never going back to over drying cheap cleansers! It's The Oridary for now on!!
This cleanser was pretty good. It's very basic but dupe hydrating. I kept it in my routine for the whole use and loved it! No scent either which I loved!

This is a cream cleanser with a gel-cream texture that's nice and hydrating. It doesn't strip my skin at all. It's very basic in that there's no scent, so will be excellent for any one sensitive to fragrance. Also non-drying and non- stripping cream cleanser.

This product surprised me. The cleanser was velvety in texture and made my skin so soft. It helped heal and get rid of my blackheads and acne prone skin. I was very happy with my results. Highly recommend.

This face wash is amazing! It leaves my skin feeling smooth and moisturized. I use it everyday in the shower and it has even worked for my teenage daughter. She has acne and it has made a big difference in her skin!

I love this cleanser! The size is huge so it will last me a long time. The consistency is awesome. I can't stand cleansers that foam up and go into my nose, so I can't breathe. This cleanser lathers into a nice cream and leaves my skin feeling smooth but not tight.
This cleanser worked pretty good, but wasn't a game changer. I will use it all, but won't necessarily need to buy again! It's worth a shot though!

Normally, face cleanser that doesn't foam makes me feel like my face is still dirty. This cleanser feels like silk on my skin and my skin feels better instantly. I've made my bf who has very sensitiveskin use it and he loves it too. It smoothed out my skin and evened out my skin tone. I love it!
I have very sensitive skin. Most products turn my face red and burn me but this didn't. I actually enjoyed using this produce and will purchase it again

This cleanser did not disappoint. It is a cream consistency and does not lather, but took off my makeup fine and made my skin so so soft. It literally squeaks when I rub my face afterwards. Feels great.
The Smell of this cleanser is wonderful, to me it smells like coconut.. i am loving it and it leaves your skin feeling really fresh, clean and soft.

I am a fan of origin and this product did not disappoint. I will be adding it to my normal routine. My tween daughter and I both have sensitive skin and it's gentle enough for her but strong enough to remove my product build up.

I bought this a week ago. I have aged skin and I'm prone to painful breakouts from skin sensitivities. I have horrible reactions to foamy cleansers. This feels like I'm washing my face in coconut cream. I do use a separate make up remover for my waterproof mascara. I've used it every day, morning and night and so far so good. Non drying, no breakouts and my face feels clean. I ride a motorcycle and often get road grit in my pores. On those cleansing routines I just use a soft face brush to go a little harder at it. A face cloth drys my skin out too much. It's a product that you don't need a lot of and it washes off clean. I'm going to keep at it to the end of the tube and will likely buy it again.
Such a great cleanser. Actually leaves your skin feeling clean and fresh. No intense scent… feels great! Super happy with it will keep using it for a long time!

I initially bought this product because it was affordable and large. I've used The Ordinary products in the past and they rarely disappoint. I thought it was strange this product is to be used on dry skin and it doesn't lather but when I used it to remove my makeup, it was amazing! It almost absorbs into your skin and you can wipe in off with a warm, damp towel. I typically use it when I shower. I get my face, chest and shoulders. It cleanses but doesn't strip. Your skin won't feel tight after, it will feel silky. So far it's been effective, it's also removed these pesky little bumps that I've had on my jawline. So far I'm loving this product and I hope they don't change the formula!
Cleanser is amazing I recommend to family members and friends about this product definitely buying more products in the future 10/10 trying again

I have only been using this cleanser for a week as I need to switch to something more gentle and I am already breaking out really bad along my jawline. I use an oil melt to remove sunscreen and then this. Not really sure why it's making me break out. Could be an ingredient. Such a waste 😔

I can't use soap on my face at all (it makes my skin dry up and break out terribly), so I have been using soapless cleansers for years. I got this for free the last time I ordered a few other products from The Ordinary that are in my regular rotation. As someone with sensitive, reactive skin, trying a new product is always hit or miss, but seeing that it was a soapless cleanser I had to try it. I love it! If you follow the directions (ie massage it into DRY skin then rinse it off with warm water) it takes most makeup off beautifully. For heavier makeup you will still need a separate makeup remover, but that is true of all cleansers! This cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and healthy. I do find it just a touch drying, but I compensate by going heavier on moisturizer at night and that works like a charm. I will be rebuying this, for sure.
This product is just fine…nothing special. It doesn't foam up like I'd hope and doesn't do the best job at cleansing and removing makeup, but it's not the worst I've used either.

This is one of my favorite cleansers now! I love all products from The Ordinary so I had high expectations for this product. It lathers on nicely and it's easy to rinse off. It takes off any excess makeup I couldn't take off before and my skin feels so nice and refreshed right after. My product also makes my skin feel so soft. It did not disappoint!

This item is just okay. It didn't blow me away. It is much more gentle than anticipated. It does not remove make up at all with water, and even with a face cloth it requires being used twice. I use it as part of a triple cleansing routine now just to get rid of it. I would only recommend using this product if you have just woken up (after cleansing your face at night), and even then it does not feel as though it removes sweat or impurities in the crevices of your nose. I won't be re-buying the product. The feel is silky and nice, but it doesn't cut it for a cleanser. It was a flop for me. I thought about rating it 1 star but I thought that was a little harsh as the packaging is nice, the feel and consistency is nice, and washing your face with it feels nice but overall it has had no results and does not really do much for your skin.

I like this cleanser as it does a great job with clarifying and blasting some small acne spots and discoloration but I do find it to be slightly drying. I always pair this cleanser with the Rose Hip oil serum by the Ordinary as well!
I love this gentle make up removing face wash ! I have acne combination skin and this doesn't leave my skin too dry ! I recommend and would definitely purchase this product!

I think this cleanser is really nice and gentle on my skin. I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a moisturizing, non-scented cleanser! I'd use additional acne stuff if you have to get rid of acne though
I definitely love using this facial cleanser. It's very gentle and nonabrasive. My face felt clean after with no tackyness or anything. It also didn't dry out my face!
This cleanser is thick and creamy and great for taking off makeup. It emulsifies the products so well, after two washes and toner I'm all set. I would definitely purchase this product.

Hydrating Facial Cleanser is a true standout, lathering beautifully, cleansing effectively, and leaving skin fresh and hydrated. It's mild and can be used multiple times during the day without drying out the skin, but face washes contain relatively strong agents that can dry out your skin if overused. This one is better suited for dry or sensitive skin, whereas facewash is more appropriate for oily or combination skin types

This product did the job when it came to cleansing - is felt very hydrating and slick on the skin which was refreshing. It did have an off putting scent but it didn't last too long. Over all not bad for the price

avis.titre: Great second step for double cleansing!
avis.texte: I was on the fence at first because this product smells very much like coconut oil. It works very well at double cleansing and removing makeup without stripping away moisture. My skin has felt very hydrated since using this.

avis.titre: it feels gentle on my skin
avis.texte: I honestly loved it, it does not have an ugly smell like most cleansers do. It left my skin feeling super smooth! I would definitely recommend to my friends & family !

avis.titre: Gentle and great for dry skin
avis.texte: Overall, this cleanser is non drying and does remove light makeup. I don't think I saw a huge improvement in my skin overall, but I did enjoy how it did not strip my face when used. I wouldn't use this as the only form of make up remover, but works great after a make up eraser or some miscellaneous water to get most of the make up off first. I love that it isn't scented and is really gentle! Definitely recommend as a daily cleanser for dry or sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Great option for mom's in a hurry!
avis.texte: I really loved this cleanser because I'm a big fan of double cleansing and this worked great for that. I start with it on dry skin and then add water and more cleanser. I don't have the time to do full skincare routines now that I have a young infant. I loved how basic and to the point it is. It worked great for my dry,sensitive and very reactive skin. It was hydrating and didn't irritate my skin. My skin went crazy being postpartum and everything would irritate my skin but not this! I love that it is also unscented! Thick creamy texture that feel very hydrating and that it's actually locking in the moisture!

avis.titre: Didn't work for my dehydrated skin
avis.texte: I was excited to try this cleanser since cleansing oil and balms don't work for me, they usually break me out and sometimes dry my skin, but since this was oil and silicone free I thought it was gonna work. The 1st time I tried it didn't remove my makeup, I used on dry skin and rinsed off. I passed a cotton pad with micellar water and there was makeup residue. 2nd time I tried on dry skin and removed my makeup with a makeup eraser, it removed face makeup but not eye makeup. 3rd time I tried on dry skin again and I used a 2nd cleanser, it removed face makeup but not eye makeup since I didn't use 2nd cleanser on my eyes. The 3 times I used it, it made my face dry and tight to the point of feeling a little itchy and got whiteheads the next day, it took like a week each time for my skin to recover. I will still recommend you to try it since everyone's skin is different, unfortunately it didn't work for me.

avis.titre: Didn't work for my dehydrated skin
avis.texte: I was excited to try this cleanser since cleansing oil and balms don't work for me, they usually break me out and sometimes dry my skin, but since this was oil and silicone free I thought it was gonna work. The 1st time I tried it didn't remove my makeup, I used on dry skin and rinsed off. I passed a cotton pad with micellar water and there was makeup residue. 2nd time I tried on dry skin and removed my makeup with a makeup eraser, it removed face makeup but not eye makeup. 3rd time I tried on dry skin again and I used a 2nd cleanser, it removed face makeup but not eye makeup since I didn't use 2nd cleanser on my eyes. The 3 times I used it, it made my face dry and tight to the point of feeling a little itchy and got whiteheads the next day, it took like a week each time for my skin to recover. I will still recommend you to try it since everyone's skin is different, unfortunately it didn't work for me.
This is a great affordable cleanser for everyday use. It foams up nicely without it feeling like it is stripping your skin. I like that it is fragrance free as well.

This formula is so smooth an gentle feeling. Unfortunately I dont think it's "heavy duty" enough for me as I broke out with so many white heads almost as soon as I started using it. I want to love it as it's fragrance free and just feels so gentle but my postpartum face just needs more love.

Has the consistency of Cetaphil but with glycolipids. If I was a Cetaphil fan I would definitely purchase this over that but I do not like cream cleansers. At the price point it isn't a bad deal, however.
This cleanser is very gentle on the face. It lathers pretty well which is important to me. It also does a good job at getting make up off. I would definitely recommend this

I haven't tried anything for The Ordinary in awhile but I'm a sucker for a good cleanser so this was initially exciting. The texture of the Glycolipid Cream Cleanser has a gel like cream feel to it. Felt nice on the skin when washing but I hated that there was no type of chemical change at all when using. No emulsifying, no foaming up. When there is no change in the formulation when water is added it just feels like am I actually washing my face or just rubbing cream into it. I HATE that this product doesn't have its ingredient list on the packaging. Immediately when using I noticed a strong coconut oil scent. I am not a fan of coconut so I was surprised but when trying to see if it's listed I noticed they spent 1/3 of the space on the bottle saying face cleanser/makeup remover in 15 languages instead of listing the ingredients. I know I can look online but it should be easily accessible on the actual product.

avis.titre: Leider reinigt dieser Cleanser bei mir nicht richt
avis.texte: Weder Makeup noch meine Maskara werden richtig gelöst. Ich bleibe bei meinem the Orrdinary Squalane Cleanser. Dieser reinigt perfekt. Zudem wird mir von dem Duft übel. Würde mich interessieren ob andere auch das Empfinden haben. Sehr schade, es ist das erste Produkt welches ich von TO nicht perfekt finde.
Absolutely loved it, my face felt clean without stripping any of the oils! Gets makeup off great as well. Highly Recommend for someone with sensitive skin!

This cleanser is suitable for combination skin. It does help clear away any built up impurities from polluted air. I have some open pores and this creamy consistency isn't so harsh on my skin. After lathering, and washed off my skin feels smooth and not tightened. We love her.

I still get hormonal acne from time to time but since switching to this cleanser I've had constant huge and painful pimples. I went back to my regular cleanser and they started going away. Unfortunately not for me
I appreciate this product, really good, easy to use and perfect for my skin, thanks for send me to try, thank you, I liked! @Influenster @theordinarylab
Its definitely a lighter cleanser but that's expected with cream cleasers. It'ssoft and gentle. Dosen't irritate my sensitive skin. No hard chemicals or perfumes
This cleanser was a bit strange to use at first but I have fallen in love with it. You have to apply to a dry face which was weird but feel very nice on the skin
This is a very gentle facial cleanser. It doesn't have all of the added fragrances or other things that would otherwise cause a skin reaction. Additionally, it will also moisturize your skin.

I see a lot of people complaining about this product not being good enough at removing all makeup on its own. This is normal and expected. The product itself is perfectly fine at doing what's meant to. Let me explain… I wear makeup pretty much daily and sometimes quite a bit of it. There is just no way that I could remove it all, including sunscreen as the first layer, not to mention my skincare that goes underneath it all, all topped with foundation, powder, eye makeup with mascara, etc… in just one step. I WISH it were that easy, but it's not. So, I have a double cleansing routine. 1. I first melt away as much of that stuff layered on my face as I can with a makeup melting balm. There are so many of these on the market now to suit every budget. Actually, I hope that TO can come out with one in the near future. 2. Then, I use a separate eye makeup remover to make sure that all of my eye makeup and mascara come off. I use one by Lancome out of habit, because I've been using it for decades and even though it seems expensive, a little really goes a long way (I wet my eyes AND the cotton pads I'll use first, to make the product stretch even further, which actually also makes it more efficient), but there are other good options out there now based on similar technologies at more affordable price points. I just don't find many of them to work as well, or last as long, and I eventually end up spending the same amount, so I ultimately keep going back to Lancome's. 3. Lastly, I use a

Overall I liked this face wash. But it's marketed as a makeup remover and I had a VERY tough time getting my mascara off with this. I think it's great if you wash your face multiple times, like to get the first layer of oil and dirt off, but I wouldn't use it for a full face of makeup. Overall a good basic cleaner and a great price point.

The main reason I gave it 3 stars was because it felt like I was rubbing lotion on my face, and then washing it away. I didn't like that it had no foam, and my face didn't really feel clean afterward.
This product was not for me. I did not like the consistency and did not feel like it cleanses well. I did however, gave then product to a friend that liked it.

The consistency is very cooling and lightweight. It cleansed my face real easily and I liked the results. I have been using it consistently, I highly recommend. I have sensitive skin and it hasn't done anything to harm it. You have to put it on a dry face then wash off.

My skin is very sensitive, and lately I have not been able to keeps my whiteheads and such at bay. I have been using this and plan to continue purchasing because it was so nice and leaves my skin not feeling stripped or unclean like some sensitive face washes do.
￼ I love the ordinary products and I use this as a second cleanser. I love the way that it feels on my skin. I have definitely seen some differences since using this product.
I didn't find anything too special about this. It's a nice gentle cleaner but it doesn't remove makeup at all, and I don't think it does anything amazing for my skin.

I'm going to talk pros and cons and then get into details on why this product didn't work for me. Pros: - lightweight - not irritating - no scent cons: - does not remove makeup for me - not deep-cleansing enough I'm used to using a foaming cleanser every day, such as the Paula's Choice foaming cleanser. I stopped using that and replaced it with this one to try it out. this is what I saw: 3 DAYS IN: - not strong enough for me: noticing redness on and around nose, where my pores are widest. Normally, I do have to do more upkeep in this area to keep the skin clear here.
